messages:
sam: Heads-up: on-call alert just hit — p99 on /v1/generate jumped from ~280ms to ~1.1s starting 10:47 UTC. Affects redwood-2b-quant in prod-us-west-2. :rotating_light:

maria: saw it, looking at traces now. Customer C-12345 also opened a ticket, they reported timeouts. Can anyone reproduce locally?

lee: I can repro with batch size=1 on a small seq length (64) when flashattn is enabled. p95 fine, p99 tail huge. local trace shows attention kernel falling back then spinning.

sam: repro steps?

lee: short script:
```bash
export REDWOOD_MODEL=redwood-2b-quant
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \n    -d '{"model":"'$REDWOOD_MODEL'","input":"hello world","max_tokens":64}' &
  sleep 0.05
done
wait
```
I see a few requests that spike to ~1s.

maria: logs show these kernel compile flags were rolled out yesterday as part of a perf patch: `--enable-sdpa=true --flash-attn=auto --compile-heuristics=v2`. Noted that SDPA runtime heuristic recently changed thresholds.

infra-bot: [deploy] canary rollout 2026-03-16T09:12 by @buildbot: 20% nodes on redwood-2b-quant received new kernel flags.

sam: sounds like kernel heuristic misclassification — maybe SDPA picks suboptimal path for short sequences. Can we force fallback to the legacy kernel for the affected shape as a mitigation?

lee: quick mitigation: flip env var on the serving pool:
```bash
# on prod pool-quant-usw2
redwoodctl set-config pool-quant-usw2 ATTENTION_PREFERENCE=sdpa:0,flash:1,generic:1 --reason "p99 regression revert"
```
I'll push that to canary.

maria: doing it now on canary (5% nodes). Monitoring p99.

oncall-bot: alert muted for 30m by @maria.

(5m later)

maria: Canary looks good — p99 back to ~320ms. Rolling to 100% now.

julian: customer update: C-12345 timeouts resolved after the rollback, they confirmed lower latency. :thumbsup:

sam: action items: 1) revert heuristic change in next release, 2) add unit test for short-seq kernel selector, 3) add automated canary for compile-flag rollouts that monitors p99 for <128 token shapes.

lee: created ticket RN-452: "sdpa heuristic misclassifies short seqs -> fallback to flash/generic" with repro and logs.

maria: also found a subtle race in kernel-cache invalidation when toggling compile flags that could exacerbate tail stalls — adding a small serialization on reload.

sam: can we add a temporary runtime safety guard: if p99 > 800ms for 5m, force kernel preference to generic and alert the oncall?

lee: yes, I'll add a rule to the routing service. Patch in staging in a few mins.

infra-bot: [rollout] pool-quant-usw2 ATTENTION_PREF change applied to 100% nodes at 09:42 UTC.

maria: creating a short postmortem draft in #incidents and will include timeline, root cause, mitigation, and follow-ups. Assigning owners: lee -> fix heuristic, sam -> canary test infra, julian -> customer comms.

sam: thanks all. Quick note: keep the canary window longer for kernel/compile flag changes next time (at least 30m).

lee: ack. Adding to deployment playbook. (reacted with :eyes:)
